newsitem.title: UK: NWE mogas tracks sideways, July trades $186.25.
newsitem.headline: NWE mogas tracks sideways, July trades $186.25.

text.p: NWE gasoline was little changed on Tuesday morning with July swaps trading at $186.25 a tonne but no trade reported on physical barges.
"The market is deadly quiet but its not that soft. I don't see that much oil around in the first half of July," said a broker.

Rotterdam barges talked $187 fob for running refinery product but $1 lower for stored product. Cargoes were thin and finding little support from the US which talked the equivalent of $204 a tonne in New York.
Further forward August swaps talked either side of $185 with September nearer $183.
